Contigo helps people manage and secure the things important to them using advanced wireless and location technologies. We develop and manage the industry's leading location-based services platform for asset-tracking, fleet management and lone worker safety applications. Founded in 2002, Contigo is now a part of the Vecima Networks Inc Telematics Division. We deliver our suite of products to value-added resellers, major wireless carriers and enterprise customers, leveraging our rapid- cycle product development processes and our patented SaaS platform. In the past, Contigo has received the following awards: Red Herring 100 Global Winner , Profit 100 Canada's Fastest Growing Companies, Business in Vancouver's Top 100 Fastest Growing Companies, Ready to Rocket 25, and IDC Canada's Ten To Watch. We are looking for a Quality Assurance Analyst to assist with the ongoing testing of our suite of web-based GPS tracking applications and devices. In this role you will have the opportunity to work on cutting edge software applications, and test the functional performance of next-generation GPS tracking devices. The ideal candidate is highly-motivated and passionate, and is looking for a challenge in a growing company. We value creativity and innovation, and willingness to step up to the plate. An ability to work in a team environment is critical. You must be a self- starter, and be able to work independently with a "can-do" attitude. Job Description: § Develop and maintain test cases to meet functional requirements for GPS-based tracking devices § Develop and maintain test scripts using automated testing tools § Execute extensive manual and automated testing § Identify and report bugs using the defect tracking system, verify fixes, and manage through to resolution § Assist in end-to-end testing of our Web and Mobile Portals before each release § Must be highly motivated, focusing on QA test process and its relationship to producing a quality end product. Job Requirements Required Qualifications: § Good understanding of QA methodologies, testing techniques, and software development lifecycle § Some software server-side or Web development experience § Excellent problem troubleshooting, diagnostic, planning, and time management skills § Very strong analytical and organizational skills § Strong and effective oral, written, and presentation skills § Work on several projects at the same time and work closely with other teams § Good team player and strong interpersonal skills Desired Skills: § Experience with testing GUI and web based applications § Experience with testing mobile apps (iPhone and Android) § Experience in Agile, particularly in Scrum § Experience working in both Windows and Linux environments § Understanding of wireless networks and protocols § Understanding of GPS and mapping technology For more information on our company, please visit http://www.contigo.com Citizenship Requirement N/A APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through UBC Science Co-op Cover Letter Required?
